```python
TensorSpec(shape: Tuple[_ShapeEntry, ...], dtype: np.dtype, device: Optional[Device] = None, name: Optional[str] = None)
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Describes a future runtime tensor (no storage).

## Attributes

- `shape` · `Tuple[_ShapeEntry, ...]` — Tuple of `Dim | DimExpr | int | None`. `None` = runtime
  dynamic (unchecked). Rank is always known. Normalized to a tuple
  on construction.

- `dtype` · `np.dtype` — The tensor dtype; normalized to a `numpy.dtype` on
  construction (accepts anything `evoxc.dtype` accepts).

- `device` · `Optional[Device]` — Optional `Device` the tensor is expected on
  (`None` = unspecified/any).

- `name` · `Optional[str]` — Optional name for the tensor (debugging, signatures, binding).

## rank

The (always known) rank of the described tensor.
